title: World gallery home · desk and collection
brief: Design three alternative previews for an adapted main camera framing: screens and speakers lead the scene while all three glass display cases behind the sofa remain visible and individually discoverable. Design only; live /world camera and interaction are unchanged.

artboards.title: In-scene markers
artboards.tradeoff: Direct object-linked buttons with minimal persistent chrome; depends on accurate projected positions and occlusion handling in the eventual 3D implementation.

artboards.title: Collection rail
artboards.tradeoff: Stable, accessible labels and clear case mapping across camera angles; bottom rail covers part of the sofa and scene.

artboards.title: Focus preview
artboards.tradeoff: Explicit one-case-at-a-time navigation and return path; uses a larger side menu and temporarily shifts attention away from the desk.
